reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: These patches work really well for me! They help reduce the swelling of my pimples noticeably, especially overnight. They're easy to use, stay in place, and don't irritate my skin.
reviews.zh: 呢款貼片對我好有效！佢哋可以明顯減少我嘅痘痘紅腫，特別係夜晚。好易用、貼得穩，又唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: These patches are really handy for those annoying little spots. They stick well, feel comfortable, and don't irritate my skin. I like how easy they are to use, especially overnight. Would buy again!
reviews.zh: 呢款貼片對付啲煩人嘅小痘痘好方便。貼得好穩，感覺舒服，唔會刺激皮膚。我鍾意佢好易用，特別係夜晚。會再買！

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: This works really well especially if you're getting impatient with those highly inflamed pruritic pimples. Gets the job done and is easy to use.
reviews.zh: 如果你對啲好紅腫、好痕嘅痘痘唔耐煩嘅話，呢款效果特別好。都做到嘢，又易用。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: he patches stick well and are very effective. They help reduce redness and protect blemishes. Easy to use and comfortable on the skin.
reviews.zh: 貼片貼得好穩，效果好好。可以減少泛紅，保護暗瘡位。易用，貼喺皮膚上都舒服。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: チクチクする感触が心地よく、とても気に入っています。保存用のジップ付き袋もあり衛生的で安心です。スキンケア後に寝る前に貼ると、翌日には腫れがほぼ消え、貼るだけで大助かりです。使用後のニードルは溶けてしまうように見えますが、有効成分がしっかり働いているのを実感できます。何度もリピートしているお気に入りで、おすすめで。✨
reviews.zh: 刺刺嘅感覺令我覺得幾舒服，好鍾意。仲有拉鏈袋可以保存，好衛生，好安心。護膚之後瞓覺前貼，第二日紅腫幾乎消晒，只係貼一貼已經幫咗好大忙。用完之後嗰啲針睇落好似溶咗，我可以感受到有效成分真係有效地發揮作用。我已經多次回購，係我嘅心頭好，推薦！✨

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9P+3P
reviews.text: Fab product to calm those swollen pimples rising from under the skin. You feel very slight prick when putting it on and you have to hold it in place for a few seconds. Put them on before sleep after skincare and the next day, the swelling is 85-90% gone. The needles must be made from the active ingredient because it seemed to have all melted away when you take the patch off after use. It’s my first time trying out one of the needle patches and very happy they are effective. Will definitely buy more to keep for emergency uses.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅產品，可以舒緩皮下浮起嘅紅腫痘痘。貼嗰陣會有非常輕微嘅刺痛感，要壓住幾秒。護膚後瞓覺前貼，第二日紅腫已經消咗85至90%。啲針一定係用有效成分造嘅，因為用完撕走個貼片嗰陣，佢哋好似全部溶咗咁。呢個係我第一次試針型貼片，好開心佢哋有效。我一定會再買多啲，留返應急用。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9+3 Sheets
reviews.text: I have always used acne patches and normally they never work for me, but this product surprised me. It even works for ingrown pimples, or pimples that are inside the skin and cannot be squeezed out. They disappear after applying the patch just once, I will definitely buy it again.
reviews.zh: 我一直都有用痘痘貼，通常對我都冇效，但係呢款令我好驚喜。佢甚至對內生性痘痘（長喺皮膚入面、擠唔到出嚟嘅痘）都有效。只係貼一次，痘痘就消失咗，我一定會再買。

reviews.shade: BIOHEAL BOH Panthecell Repair Cica Micro Spot Patch 9+3 Sheets
reviews.text: I use these so often for those big pimples that I know wil leave a scar. I let these do their magic and it goes away! I will keep em one for hours
reviews.zh: 我成日都用呢款，對付嗰啲我知道會留疤嘅大粒痘痘。我畀佢哋發揮魔法，痘痘就會消失！我會貼住幾個鐘。
